WITH prior_round AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.year, r.round,
         (SELECT p.raceId
          FROM races p
          WHERE p.year = r.year AND p.round < r.round
          ORDER BY p.round DESC
          LIMIT 1) AS priorRaceId
  FROM races r
), gains AS (
  SELECT pr.raceId, c.country,
         ds.wins - CASE
           WHEN pr.priorRaceId IS NULL THEN 0
           ELSE prev.wins
         END AS wins_gained
  FROM prior_round pr
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = (
    SELECT r.circuitId FROM races r WHERE r.raceId = pr.raceId
  )
  JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.raceId = pr.raceId
  LEFT JOIN driverStandings prev
    ON prev.raceId = pr.priorRaceId AND prev.driverId = ds.driverId
  WHERE c.country IS NOT NULL
), race_averages AS (
  SELECT country, raceId, AVG(wins_gained) AS avg_wins_gained
  FROM gains
  GROUP BY country, raceId
), country_averages AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(avg_wins_gained) AS avg_wins_gained
  FROM race_averages
  GROUP BY country
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins_gained) AS overall_benchmark
  FROM country_averages
), above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins_gained, b.overall_benchmark
  FROM country_averages ca CROSS JOIN benchmark b
  WHERE ca.avg_wins_gained > b.overall_benchmark
), second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins_gained) AS mean_above_benchmark
  FROM above_benchmark
)
SELECT ab.country,
       ab.avg_wins_gained AS average,
       ab.avg_wins_gained - ab.overall_benchmark AS above_overall_benchmark,
       ab.avg_wins_gained - sm.mean_above_benchmark AS above_second_mean
FROM above_benchmark ab
CROSS JOIN second_mean sm
WHERE ab.avg_wins_gained > sm.mean_above_benchmark;

assumptions.assumption: Circuit rows with a NULL country are excluded because they do not identify a country. If a driver has a standings row at the current race but no row at the immediately previous race round, that driver's gain is treated as missing and ignored by AVG; the first round in a season uses zero as the prior count.
